item.description:
Thimble 0.2.1 brings the first Android release, and makes sync safer on the Mac.
**Android, for the first time** - Every list, with projects, areas, headings, checklists, tags, deadlines, repeats, and reminders, in English and French. - Encrypted sync with your Mac through the same folder and passphrase. - A Today widget, a New Thimble Task tile in Quick Settings, and Share into Thimble from any app. - Project cards and the Dashboard. Tags show as pills, and a project's tags filter its tasks. - Calendar events in Today and Upcoming, daily backups to a folder you choose, and a lock with your phone's screen lock. - It asks for no internet access. Download the `.apk` below; it needs Android 12 or later.
**Mac** - Fixed: after an update, sync could take empty project cards for real edits and send them to your other devices. Thimble now knows a field that's new to it isn't something you changed.
The new [help page](https://github.com/matguitarist/thimble/blob/main/HELP.md) covers installing, syncing, and the rest.
